_comment: Tier-2: the yield-surface tags VonMises / Tresca / DruckerPrager / MohrCoulomb / ModifiedMohrCoulomb / Rankine / SimoJu are not constitutive laws on their own — they exist only as substrings inside a composite law name. Pitfall (kratos.constitutive_laws #7). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv). Kernel.HasConstitutiveLaw() is False for all seven bare tags and True for the composite SmallStrainIsotropicPlasticity3DVonMisesVonMises, so {"constitutive_law": {"name": "VonMises"}} in Materials.json cannot resolve. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics for real; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
